_README: Verified plausible price bands per ticker, read off accredited external
sources. These exist because local continuity alone cannot decide which of
two conflicting price levels is real when corruption alternates: SMER spends
355 days at ~3.00 and 200 days at ~0.30 across 2019-2021, switching 48 times,
so flank-relative logic yields contradictory corrections for adjacent runs.
A band is the range the stock genuinely traded in during that window. A run
whose median falls OUTSIDE the band, and which a single power of ten brings
INSIDE it, is a decimal-shift correction. Everything else is left alone.
CRITICAL: low price does NOT imply corruption. HAFR and NBV genuinely traded
below 1.00 KES for years - their bands say so explicitly, which is what stops
a fixer from multiplying real prices tenfold.
Add a ticker here only after checking a real source. Unanchored tickers are
reported for review and never auto-corrected.

SMER.name: Sameer Africa Plc
SMER.note: Chart axis floor is 1.5; never traded near 0.30. The ~0.30 series is corruption, the ~3.00 series is real.

TOTL.name: TotalEnergies Marketing Kenya Plc
TOTL.note: Trades 20-45 KES. Never near 1.28 or 3.50 - those runs are corruption. MA(200)=23.66, current 43.40.

HAFR.name: Home Afrika Limited
HAFR.note: GENUINELY SUB-1 for years. Chart tooltip Oct-2021 reads O 0.40 H 0.40 L 0.36 C 0.40. The ~10-12 runs in 2017-2018 are the corruption (real level ~1.0-1.2), NOT the low prices.

NBV.name: Nairobi Business Ventures Plc
NBV.note: GENUINELY SUB-1 in 2018-2020 (~0.3-0.6), then a real spike to ~10 in 2021 and a long decline to 1.38. The sub-1 prices are REAL and must not be multiplied.

KPLC.name: Kenya Power and Lighting Company Plc
reason: DO NOT auto-correct. The 2010-2011 level changes the detector flags
(flanks 140.00 vs 17.90, then 2.25 vs 15.25) line up with KPLC's share
split, which is a real corporate action, not corruption. MarketScreener
back-adjusts for splits so its chart looks continuous while the raw NSE
series legitimately steps. 'Correcting' a split would destroy real data.
Separately, KPLC genuinely traded around 1.3-2.0 during 2019-2022 - the
deep trough is visible on the chart and is real.
